title: refactor: simplify community endpoint handling and tests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Centralizes community endpoint error-body parsing for Enter and Gen callers.
- Shares repeated community fallback fixtures while preserving text, image, pricing, billing, and authorization coverage.
- Removes 141 net lines across runtime and test code without changing public response shapes.
- Supersedes #12912 and #12926.

Checks:
- Biome on all four changed runtime/test files
- Enter changed-file typecheck and billing-registry tests
- Full Gen test suite and TypeScript typecheck
- CodeQL

gist.headline: One error path to tend
gist.blurb: The community endpoint callers now share one careful little error parser instead of growing their own. Fewer duplicated branches, same responses, tidier garden.
gist.summary: Centralized community endpoint error-body parsing in shared/community-endpoints.ts for both Enter and Gen, while consolidating fallback test fixtures without changing public response shapes.
gist.impact: Enter and Gen community endpoint behavior remains consistent across text, image, pricing, billing, and authorization cases, with less duplicated runtime and test code to maintain.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends two neighboring retro terminal plants labeled Enter and Gen, whose tangled error-message vines now join into one neat shared root beneath a garden sign. A cheerful CRT monitor robot helps sort identical code leaves into a single basket, representing shared parsing and fixtures.
